title: vaoXR 0.2.0

creators.name: Ukolov, Dominik
creators.affiliation: Digital Humanities (Image/Object), Friedrich Schiller University Jena; Research Group DIGITAL ORGANOLOGY, Leipzig University

description:
vaoXR is a web application for exploring a historic positive organ through its 3D model, recordings, sampled stops, and performance animation. The curated Cuntz organ uses VAO 0.5.0 data release 0.5.0-2.

Version 0.2.0 adds a local inspector for VAO 0.5.0 and 0.6.0 manifests and carriers. It shows declared profiles and can preview supported embedded audio after verifying the recorded size and SHA-256. It also includes the deployed sustain-loop repair for the sampled organ.

The archive contains the software source. The media setup script downloads the pinned instrument assets separately and checks their hashes. Original code is Apache-2.0 and original documentation is CC BY 4.0. See NOTICE and THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for file-level scope.
notes: SHA256SUMS identifies the tagged software source archive. The instrument dataset has its own release identifier.
